name: grove-fhir
description: Build and validation tooling for the Grove FHIR implementation guides

scripts.test: npm run schema:check && npm run release:check && python3 Scripts/check-content.py && python3 Scripts/check-terminology.py && python3 Scripts/render-measurement-profiles.py --check && python3 Scripts/render-format-registry.py --check && python3 Scripts/render-artifact-allowlist.py --check && python3 -m unittest discover -s Tests -v
scripts.schema:check: node Scripts/validate-json-schema.cjs catalog/schemas/release-manifest.schema.json catalog/release-manifest.json && node Scripts/validate-json-schema.cjs catalog/schemas/exchange-protocol.schema.json catalog/exchange-protocol.json && node Scripts/validate-json-schema.cjs catalog/schemas/measurement-catalog.schema.json catalog/measurement-catalog.json && node Scripts/validate-json-schema.cjs catalog/schemas/package-graph.schema.json catalog/package-graph.json && node Scripts/validate-json-schema.cjs catalog/schemas/artifact-allowlist.schema.json publication/artifact-allowlist.json && node Scripts/validate-json-schema.cjs catalog/schemas/catalog-contracts.schema.json catalog/format-registry.json catalog/health-connect-adapter.json catalog/healthkit-adapter.json catalog/providers-adapter.json catalog/sensor-catalog.json catalog/sensorkit-adapter.json catalog/profile-claims.json && node Scripts/validate-json-schema.cjs Conformance/producer-manifest.schema.json Conformance/example-producer/manifest.json Conformance/corpora/mobile-exchange/official-validator-manifest.json
